sample_unit: chest radiograph reports (202 English MIMIC-CXR, 197 German)

links.outcome: LLM report structuring accuracy (MCC) in English versus German reports
links.effect: Average MCC 0.75 (94% HDI 0.70-0.80) for English versus 0.66 (0.62-0.70) for German; LLM-human MCC differences within ROPE for both languages.
links.quote: However, the understanding of semantics varied across languages and imaging findings.

unlisted_practices: Constrained decoding/output control to guarantee valid structured LLM output
On-premise locally hosted open-source LLM for privacy preservation

screen.reason: The study evaluates an open-source, on-premise LLM on retrospective free-text radiology reports compared to human raters for structuring data, but does not compare outcomes with vs without an organizational deployment practice or safeguard.
